case_mapping: u1-u3: unreaded JPEGs sorted by filename; a1-a3: accepted JPEGs sorted by filename. Images and OCR remain private.
method: One pass per image through production normalization, OCR, extraction and validation; no stage or confirmation methods called. Persistent conservative per-request task guard plus existing global PostgreSQL accounting. Legacy contract replay uses the same new extraction outputs, not a paired baseline model run.

cases.interpretation: Expected safe clarification: transfer direction was not provided.
OCR passed; extraction was not sent because its conservative reservation exceeded the remaining task allowance.

limitations: Only four completed extractions; one transfer needs user direction, one extraction was blocked before dispatch by the task reservation guard.
Amount and date match checks use manually inspected image labels; they are not an exhaustive score for every field.
No paired live baseline, repeated-run reliability estimate, provider cost comparison or production Telegram acceptance test.
